responsibility: This header declares the public interface to the mc front end's name-interning subsystem. It defines the stable nameKey_Name type and NulName constant and exports operations for interning strings into keys, recovering character data from keys, querying lengths and existence, printing names, and performing case-insensitive key comparison.
same_name_distinction: Declares the external API and public types/constants for the name-key interning subsystem, but unlike GnameKey.cc it does not contain the binary-tree/index storage or the implementation of key creation and lookup.
